excerpt: Update: On December 22, 2023, New York State Governor Kathy Hochul vetoed the bill that would ban all new non-competition agreements for workers in New York. News reports indicate that Governor Hochul sought to limit the ban on non-compete agreements to individuals earning up to US$250,000, while sponsors of the bill were ultimately agreeable to a US$300,000 limit, and both sides differed on how bonuses and stock options should be counted for this purpose.
